meta.name: image-seo
meta.description: Image SEO audit — make a site's images discoverable in Google Images and stop them from dragging down Core Web Vitals. Audits alt text quality and coverage, descriptive file names, modern formats (WebP/AVIF), dimensions and compression, responsive srcset, lazy-loading, explicit width/height (CLS), image sitemaps, and ImageObject structured data. Use this skill whenever the user asks about image SEO, alt text, Google Images ranking, image optimization for search, image file size hurting page speed, WebP/AVIF, or image structured data. Trigger on: "image SEO", "alt text", "rank in Google Images", "optimize my images for search", "image alt tags", "WebP", "image compression SEO", "image sitemap", "ImageObject schema", or any image-discoverability / image-performance question. For overall page speed use /seo-analysis; for generating new images use the brand image skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提升网站图片在谷歌图片搜索中的排名与性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站图片在谷歌图片中排名低或拖慢页面速度
copy.tagline_en: Boost your site's image discoverability in Google Images and Core Web Vitals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site images rank poorly in Google Images or hurt page speed

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查网页图片的 alt 文本、文件名、格式、大小、响应式设置、懒加载、尺寸声明、图片站点地图和结构化数据，并给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你询问图片 SEO、alt 文本、Google 图片排名、图片优化、WebP、图片压缩、图片站点地图或图片结构化数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个页面的图片 SEO 问题。
say.note: Claude 会分析页面图片并给出评分和修复列表。

say.text: 我的图片 alt 文本写得好吗？
say.note: Claude 会检查 alt 文本是否缺失或重复。

say.text: 这个页面的图片该转成 WebP 吗？
say.note: Claude 会检查格式并建议转换。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits images on a page for alt text, file names, formats, file size, responsive settings, lazy-loading, explicit dimensions, image sitemaps, and structured data, then provides fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about image SEO, alt text, Google Images ranking, image optimization, WebP, image compression, image sitemaps, or image structured data.

say_en.text: Check the image SEO issues on this page.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and give a score and fix list.

say_en.text: Are my image alt texts good?
say_en.note: Claude checks for missing or duplicate alt text.

say_en.text: Should I convert these images to WebP?
say_en.note: Claude checks format and suggests conversion.
